lessons: Check failed in the full tests/unit run: tests/unit/test_roadmap_accept.py:29 does `from tests.unit.test_roadmap_author import FakeGit`, and the diff deleted class FakeGit. test_roadmap_accept.py is outside the Scope fence, so do not edit it.

Keep an importable name `FakeGit` in tests/unit/test_roadmap_author.py as a factory `def FakeGit(repo)` that returns a tests/git_fake.py GitFake. The adoption PATTERN matches only `class FakeGit`, so a def does not count as a stand-in.

test_roadmap_accept.py reads and sets checkout.git.dirty, .files and .commits (lines 143-406). The factory must set those as instance attributes and pass status_porcelain/_run/commit overrides that read them and append (message, only, roadmap text) to .commits, as the old class did.

Before committing, run the full unit gate `./dev.py test tests/unit` as well as the two Verification commands. Both of those passed, but they skip the modules that import from the migrated files. Also grep tests/ for imports from all 13 migrated files.
